historic_survey.note: The first house Henry Doelger built in the Sunset District. Later the same year he began his first whole tract on this block, a solid run of barrel front Mediterranean Revival houses between Judah and Kirkham Streets with alternating parapet forms, put forward as a candidate for its own historic district survey.

historical_record.description: The first house Henry Doelger built in the Sunset District, a barrel-front single-family house. The Western Neighborhoods Project identified and confirmed the address.
